PZZ700-210815-
1205 PM PDT Tue Oct 20 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1012 mb high was 600 nautical miles west of Punta 
Colonet, Mexico, a 1006 mb low was southern Arizona, and a 1007 
mb low at the core of a Pacific storm was 600 nautical miles west
of Point Conception. Southerly flow increases tonight through 
Wednesday. A storm system will move through the coastal waters 
late Wednesday through Thursday, bringing rain and a slight chance
of thunderstorms. Southerly winds will shift to westerly then 
northwest early Thursday. Weak offshore flow during the nights and
mornings will alternate with onshore northwest flow during the 
afternoons and evenings Friday through Saturday. 

$$
